verses.2: May the LORD remove me from the hands of evil men and from the hands of those who are hostile to me.
verses.3: Those who think evil in their hearts will be kept away from wars every day.
verses.4: We have changed them like a scorpion that is now under our feet.
verses.5: May the LORD protect me from the evil of those who want to prevent me from doing what I must do.
verses.6: They covered me with blankets and ropes. They set up barriers around my hands. They tied me up tightly.
verses.7: I said to Jehovah, “You are my voice. Hear, O Jehovah, the cry of my plea.”
verses.8: Yehovah, Adonai, my strength, my savior! May You protect me on the day of my death.
verses.9: May the LORD not give any time to those wicked people. May they not be allowed to succeed in their schemes.
verses.10: The head of the messenger is covered with his own lips.
verses.11: They will be covered with flames of fire; they will be destroyed in the midst of chaos and destruction.
verses.12: A man who is not worthy of living on this earth, a man who is evil and deserves to be punished.
verses.13: I knew that Jehovah would deal with the poor in a just manner, as He did to our ancestors.
verses.14: But the righteous will praise your name; they will sit before your face in righteousness.
